It wraps the analyzer's report callback so that a diagnostic is reported only when its location is in a syntax tree of the compilation being analyzed. The analyzer's symbol action now sends only classes with [MessagePackObject] (plus [Union] interfaces) to TypeCollector, so structs are no longer passed. New tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata-only image and check that the analyzers and generator give no diagnostics and that the resolver is generated.
